verdicts.reason: A: the wind-turbine hero icon shrinks to a tiny glyph in a cramped bottom row of shape fragments, the red triangle sits awkwardly in the middle, and a stray line runs up toward the headline, which is crammed into the right half beside dead space on the left. B: the turbine is also shrunk to a trivial icon, squeezed into a cluttered top strip of cropped shapes, and the diagonal lines crowd the right edge of the text. Still, B's large left-aligned headline block reads clearly and anchors the canvas better, so it is the less broken of the two.
